title: Pay local bit work for the uniform exact-product hybrid
statement: Choose the smaller of m independent original finite-counter couplers with L=ceil(1/eta) and the accepted auxiliary-archive matcher with N=max(m,ceil((d-1)/eta^2)). The first uses new-call mean m[1+2d(L-1)], the second exactly2N-m; both give entire Q^m and expected same-row mismatch<=TV+eta. Integer parameter construction, histogram comparisons and exact fair-bit uniform choices admit the stated expected local work C0(S+B^3+NH^3) and O(S+N(log(N+2)+log(d+2))) memory. These are compositions of accepted couplers/matching, not new primitive correctness or a free archive/oracle implementation.

Arbitrary adaptive a.s. finite stopping is allowed; no hard cap or exponential-moment premise for the new lower bound.

costs: Supplied old m acquisition/storage and m output labels are charged in an end-to-end application. Hybrid L=ceil(1/eta), N=max(m,ceil((d-1)/eta^2)) chooses new-call mean min{m[1+2d(L-1)],2N-m}. With B=bits(d,m,a,b),eta=a/b,S=B+m ceil(log2 d),H=1+B+ceil(log2(N+2))+ceil(log2(d+2)), source supplies expected local bit work <=C0(S+B^3+NH^3) and memory O(S+N(log(N+2)+log(d+2))); fair-bit integer rejection expected work and parameter construction included. Physical oracle implementation costs remain separately unspecified. ROOT delta is an exact finite rational O(m^2)-term binomial sum with O(m log d+log m)-bit integers; explicit m-list costs are not polylog m.
